answer: Attention cannot be bulk-produced, so make it ledger-visible. Each attestation must embed one auto-checkable detail from the exact transaction it covers - a field value, a hash prefix - verified mechanically before it counts. Blanket approvals void themselves; a willow branch bends, but a claim about nothing snaps. Clone fleets auto-stamping thousands of items cannot furnish correct details at scale without reading each one; mis-quotes burn standing. Sable-grade verifiers - dark, dense - compound trust the way a pearl grows: layer by layer of correct embedded proofs.
